title: GAIA: Geometry-Adaptive Operator Learning for Forward and Inverse Problems
abstract: arXiv:2607.01128v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Operator learning for partial differential equations (PDEs) on arbitrary geometries builds fast neural surrogates for large-scale simulation. While recent geometry-adaptive neural operators have made substantial progress, they are mainly designed for forward problems in which inputs and outputs share the same spatial domain. This limits their applicability for boundary value problems (BVPs) and inverse problems, where inputs and outputs may live on different domains. We introduce the Geometry-Adaptive Integral Autoencoder (GAIA), an operator learning model that encodes the domain boundary and the interior field distribution into geometry tokens, and conditions integral transform layers on these tokens via cross-attention, allowing the kernel to adapt locally to geometric features. translated_title: GAIA：面向正问题与逆问题的几何自适应算子学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.01128v2 公告类型： replace 摘要：在任意几何结构上对偏微分方程（PDE）进行算子学习，可为大规模仿真构建快速的神经代理模型。尽管近期的几何自适应神经算子已取得长足进展，但它们主要针对正问题设计，即输入与输出共享同一空间域。这限制了它们在边值问题（BVPs）和逆问题中的应用，因为在这类问题中输入和输出可能位于不同的域上。我们提出了几何自适应积分自编码器（GAIA），这是一种算子学习模型，它将域边界和内部场分布编码为几何标记，并通过交叉注意力机制将这些标记作为积分变换层的条件，使核函数能够局部适应几何特征。由此得到的架构能够学习任意域上正问题与逆问题的解算子，并以单次前向传递的方式求解每个问题……
tldr: GAIA提出了一种几何自适应积分自编码器架构，通过将域边界与内部场分布编码为几何标记并经交叉注意力调制积分变换层，首次实现了任意几何域上正问题与逆问题（输入输出可处于不同域）的统一算子学习。
en_tdlr: GAIA introduces a geometry-adaptive integral autoencoder that encodes domain boundaries and interior field distributions into geometry tokens to condition integral transform layers via cross-attention, enabling unified operator learning for both forward and inverse problems on arbitrary geometries where inputs and outputs may live on different domains.
